name: Botub AI
description: AI-powered chatbot and website analysis app with a React frontend and Express API.

VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY.description: Firebase client API key used by the Vite frontend.

VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN.description: Firebase Auth domain for the frontend app.

VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Firebase project ID used by the frontend app.

VITE_FIREBASE_DATABASE_ID.description: Firestore database ID. Usually the same as the Firebase project ID or '(default)'.

VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Firebase Storage bucket for the frontend app.

VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID.description: Firebase app ID for the frontend app.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for chatbot and analysis responses.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional Groq API key used as the fallback AI provider.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP hostname for outbound report and lead emails.

SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP port for the configured mail server.

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP username or sender email for report and lead notifications.

SMTP_PASS.description: SMTP password or app-specific password for the sender account.

SMTP_SECURE.description: Set to true for implicit TLS SMTP connections, typically when using port 465.

FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: Single-line Firebase service account JSON for backend admin access.

FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional Firebase project ID for backend status checks. Usually the same as VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.
